verdicts.why: Row matches its own LEGO L2 'of the main road'; seed has 'along the main road' where 'of' is not rendered, so the words are present but 'of' is dropped.
ಅಂತ is a complementiser particle glossed 'that', which the seed 'how tired you were' does not render.
ಅನ್ನೋ is a quotative particle glossed 'that', which the seed 'about how it all started' does not render.
ಅಂದ್ರೆ 'that is' is a literal gloss of a word the seed 'The sensible thing to do would have been' does not render.
Seed has "It's a long time" and the row has "it's been", an inflected variant of the copula, so no single contiguous seed value is forced.
Seed has "I'm ready" with 'am' contracted into "I'm", so 'am' is not a separate substring.
Row 'as possible' differs from the LEGO 'as hard as I can' and the seed 'as hard as I can'; no single forced value.
Seed has "It's not a problem" with 'is' contracted and 'not' split off, so "isn't" is not a contiguous substring.
Seed has 'helping me', and the row 'to help' is a different inflection of the same verb.
Seed has 'somewhere' and the row 'anywhere' is a near-synonym of the word in the sentence; the choice is a judgement call.
ಹೆಚ್ಚು glossed 'more' where the seed renders the LEGO as 'not far ahead'; the row is about its sentence and the gloss is a policy call.
Seed has "It's next to" with 'is' contracted into "It's", so 'is' is not a separate substring.
Seed has 'it will work' and the row 'will do' splits that with 'work' absent, so the words are not contiguous.
Seed has 'seems to be working' and the row "doesn't seem" is a negated variant; 'Nothing' carries the negation.
Seed has "it's so good" with 'is' contracted into "it's", so 'is good' is not contiguous.
Seed has 'need to work hard' and the row 'need to do' has 'work hard' interposed.
Seed has "I'm starting" and the row "I'm doing" glosses ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ literally, which the seed does not render.
Row 'most' glosses ಅತ್ಯಂತ literally while the seed and LEGO render it as 'the least'; the LEGOs disagree with the seed.
ಮಾಡಿದೆ glossed 'did' is a literal gloss of a light verb that the seed 'started to think' does not render.
The stem 좋 split from 좋아요 gives 'like / good'; seed has 'I like', so it is an alternate gloss of a word in the sentence.
